text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا

translations.asad: CONSIDER those [stars] that rise only to set,
translations.sahih: By those [angels] who extract with violence

translations.asad: and move [in their orbits] with steady motion,
translations.sahih: And [by] those who remove with ease

translations.asad: and float [through space] with floating serene,
translations.sahih: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

translations.asad: and yet overtake [one another] with swift overtaking:
translations.sahih: And those who race each other in a race

translations.asad: and thus they fulfil the [Creator's] behest!
translations.sahih: And those who arrange [each] matter,

translations.asad: [HENCE, think of] the Day when a violent convulsion will convulse [the world],
translations.sahih: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

translations.asad: to be followed by further [convulsions]!
translations.sahih: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

translations.asad: On that Day will [men's] hearts be throbbing,
translations.sahih: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

translations.asad: [and] their eyes downcast...
translations.sahih: Their eyes humbled.

translations.asad: [And yet,] some say, "What! Are we indeed to be restored to our former state –
translations.sahih: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

translations.asad: even though we may have become [a heap of] crumbling bones?"
translations.sahih: Even if we should be decayed bones?

translations.asad: [And] they add, "That, then, would be a return with loss!"
translations.sahih: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

translations.asad: [But,] then, that [Last Hour] will be [upon them of a sudden, as if it were] but a single accusing cry -
translations.sahih: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

translations.asad: and then, lo, they will be fully awakened [to the truth]!
translations.sahih: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

translations.asad: HAS THE STORY of Moses ever come within thy ken.
translations.sahih: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

text.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

translations.asad: Lo! His Sustainer called out to him in the twice-hallowed valley:
translations.sahih: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

translations.asad: "Go unto Pharaoh - for, verily, he has transgressed all bounds of what is right -
translations.sahih: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

text.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

translations.asad: and say [unto him], 'Art thou desirous of attaining to purity?
translations.sahih: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

translations.asad: [If so,] then I shall guide thee towards [a cognition of] thy Sustainer, so that [henceforth] thou wilt stand in awe [of Him].’"
translations.sahih: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

translations.asad: And thereupon he [went to Pharaoh and] made him aware of the great wonder [of God's grace].
translations.sahih: And he showed him the greatest sign,

translations.asad: But [Pharaoh] gave him the lie and rebelliously rejected [all guidance],
translations.sahih: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.

translations.asad: and brusquely turned his back [on Moses];
translations.sahih: Then he turned his back, striving.

translations.asad: and then he gathered [his great ones], and called [unto his people],
translations.sahih: And he gathered [his people] and called out

translations.asad: and said, "I am your Lord All-Highest!"
translations.sahih: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

translations.asad: And thereupon God took him to task, [and made him] a warning example in the life to come as well as in this world.
translations.sahih: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

translations.asad: In this, behold, there is a lesson indeed for all who stand in awe [of God].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].

text.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا

translations.asad: [O MEN!] Are you more difficult to create than the heaven which He has built?
translations.sahih: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

translations.asad: High has He reared its vault and formed it in accordance with what it was meant to be;
translations.sahih: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

translations.asad: and He has made dark its night and brought forth its light of day.
translations.sahih: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

translations.asad: And after that, the earth: wide has He spread its expanse,
translations.sahih: And after that He spread the earth.

translations.asad: and has caused its waters to come out of it, and its pastures,
translations.sahih: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

translations.asad: and has made the mountains firm:
translations.sahih: And the mountains He set firmly

translations.asad: [all this] as a means of livelihood for you and your animals.
translations.sahih: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

translations.asad: AND SO, when the great overwhelming event [of, resurrection] comes to pass –
translations.sahih: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

translations.asad: on that Day man will [clearly] remember all that he has ever wrought;
translations.sahih: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

translations.asad: and the blazing fire [of hell] will be lad open before all who [are destined to] see it.
translations.sahih: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

translations.asad: For, unto him who shall have transgressed the bounds of what is right,
translations.sahih: So as for he who transgressed

translations.asad: and preferred the life of this world [to the good of his soul],
translations.sahih: And preferred the life of the world,

translations.asad: that blazing fire will truly be the goal!
translations.sahih: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

text.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ

translations.asad: But unto him who shall have stood in fear of his Sustainer's Presence, and held back his inner self from base desires,
translations.sahih: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

translations.asad: paradise will truly be the goal!
translations.sahih: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

translations.asad: THEY WILL ASK thee [O Prophet] about the Last Hour: "When will it come to pass?"
translations.sahih: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

translations.asad: [But] how couldst thou tell anything about it,
translations.sahih: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

translations.asad: [seeing that] with thy Sustainer alone rests the beginning and the end [of all knowledge] thereof?
translations.sahih: To your Lord is its finality.

translations.asad: Thou art but [sent] to warn those who stand in awe of it.
translations.sahih: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

text.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا

translations.asad: On the Day when they behold it, [it will seem to them] as if they had tarried [in this world] no longer than one evening or [one night, ending with] its morn!
translations.sahih: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
